observations: Multiple blue gas cylinders standing outdoors on concrete.
The cylinders are cylindrical with rounded domed tops.
Visible wear and scratches on the blue paint.
A large white sticker is partially peeled off the side of the cylinders.
The valve area is not clearly visible in the provided photos.
A watermark 'DE-JOE GLOBAL SERVICES' is present on both images.

claims.evidence: The markings 'ISO 9809-3' and 'P22.8' suggest industrial use, but the actual material and construction cannot be verified from photos.
Subjective quality cannot be determined from external photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be expired or past their re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the cylinder.

risks.risk: The valve may be damaged, leaking, or incompatible.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve and a video of a leak test.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be made of inferior or scrap metal.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder's shroud or the metal at the base.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the stamped date (e.g., '2024/08') on the cylinder.
Photo of the cylinder's shroud or base to check the metal quality.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
